items.tldr: AI startups have reportedly raised ~$74.1B across 77 rounds this year; the biggest is Mistral's $3.5B Series D led by Samsung and EQT
items.tldr_zh: AI 创业公司今年已融资约 741 亿美元、77 轮；最大一笔是 Mistral 35 亿美元 D 轮，由三星和 EQT 领投
items.take: Money is flowing to infrastructure, not apps — is that a bet on an industry, or paying tolls on someone else's story?
items.take_zh: 钱砸向「基础设施」而不是「应用」——这是在押注一个行业，还是在给别人的故事交过路费？

items.tldr: Study: to make people more open to diversity, happiness may work better than awe
items.tldr_zh: 心理学研究：想让人对多元文化更开放，「快乐」可能比「敬畏」更管用
items.take: We assume awe changes people, but a good mood is what makes them yield — when did you last change your mind: persuaded, or soothed?
items.take_zh: 我们总以为震撼能改变人，结果是心情好才肯让步——你上一次改变看法，是被说服的，还是被哄好的？

items.tldr: Study: partisan hatred shapes how Americans view the BLM protests and January 6
items.tldr_zh: 研究：党派仇恨会决定美国人怎么看 BLM 抗议和 1·6 事件
items.take: Same event, two sets of facts — do people see first and pick a side, or pick a side and then see?
items.take_zh: 同一件事，两种「事实」——人到底是先看到再站队，还是先站队再看到？
